We need to find a retrosynthetic template that converts a carboxylic acid to amide (forward reaction). The target molecule is given: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "aliphatic carboxylic acid"? The description says breaking aliphatic carboxylic acid. Also bonds formed: C-N, bonds broken: C-O. So we can search.

First, maybe get available functional groups list to know naming. Let's call get_available_functional_groups.

<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will query the template catalog for reactions that break an aliphatic carboxylic acid (forming an amide) – i.e., breaking a C‑O bond of a carboxylic acid and forming a C‑N bond. This matches the forward transformation described. I’ll use the search_template_catalog_by_criteria tool with functional_groups_broken set to ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], functional_groups_formed set to ["amide"], bonds_broken set to ["C-O"], and bonds_formed set to ["C-N"]. Then I’ll inspect the returned templates, pick the most relevant one, retrieve its full SMARTS, and map the reaction SMILES to obtain the mapped_rxn. Finally, I’ll output the mapped reaction SMILES and the template_id.
We need to actually call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
